scripts.dev: cd research && OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=2 uv run --extra rave lcs-realtime-server --model-id fsl10k-16d --model ../models/external/freesoundloop10k_raspi_b2048_r44100_z16.ts --offline-model ../models/external/freesoundloop10k_raspi_b2048_r44100_z16.ts --corpus ../data/corpus/v1 --root .. --port 4174
